description_en: Retrieves the list of robot node information based on the robot ID, which is the script ID
description_zh: 根据机器人ID，即话术ID，获取机器人节点信息列表
name: ListRobotNode

parameters.help_en: The robot ID, which is the script ID. You can obtain it in the outbound robot > Script Management section of the left-side navigation pane in the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)
parameters.help_zh: 机器人ID，即话术ID。 您可以在智能联络中心控制台 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)左侧导航栏的智能外呼机器人>话术管理中获取
parameters.name: robot_id
